subject: Game Theory
title: Algorithmic Trust
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Algorithmic Trust.

hook.text: Your credit score decides if you get a house. An algorithm you've never seen controls your financial life.

buildup.text: Increasingly, algorithms decide who to trust: credit scores, hiring filters, insurance risk models, ad targeting.

discovery.text: These systems process millions of signals humans can't, detecting fraud patterns and default risks in real time.

twist.text: But algorithmic bias is real. ZIP codes correlate with race. Past data encodes past discrimination.

climax.text: The EU's AI Act now requires explanations for high-stakes algorithmic decisions. Transparency rebuilds trust.

punchline.text: Trust the algorithm? First, audit it.

quiz.question: What is a key risk of algorithmic trust systems?
